candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic March snapshot metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: BDUK values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.derived_snapshot: Ranks and shares are deterministic calculations over the displayed rounded March 2026 table and its displayed totals; rounding means rows may not sum exactly, and these metrics are not official statistics or parcel-level delivery claims.
scope_guards.consumer_saving: Ofcom saving guidance describes general options and processes; actual prices, eligibility, availability, exit fees and savings depend on the customer's contract and address.
scope_guards.pricing_rights: Ofcom price-rise guidance describes consumer protections and contract rules; applicability depends on contract date, wording and customer category and is not legal advice.
scope_guards.roaming_guidance: Ofcom roaming guidance describes general charges and prevention steps; actual coverage, charges, device compatibility and package terms depend on provider and destination.
scope_guards.switching_process: Ofcom switching guidance describes standard switching processes; individual timing, eligibility and service continuity depend on provider and case facts.
